why: The section must load through desc.load(); a section that never loads keeps its Loading note, and openRelease() waits for data-mb-art-state="ok" in vain.

name: P3: the release page's medium art ignores its settings
why: The Cover art adapter's mediumOn() carries MusicBrainz's two settings; always on, turning the setting off keeps the thumbs.

name: P3: MusicBrainz pages other than release-tracks look for foreign media
why: A performance guard, not a visible one: _artMediumAdapter() runs on every filter pass; on MusicBrainz it must return before querying the document. Nothing on screen differs, so no spec can see it: recorded as an overlap.

name: P4a: the Table layout is a table.tbl
